A constructive extension beyond the two-bin model

The strongest result is now a positive, recursively updated description of a class of interacting, replenished quantum systems, with an error bound for the complete permitted record under feedback.

The construction retains quantum noise correlations that the earlier isotropic source omitted. It then modifies those correlations only where they would prevent a positive classical evolution. The resulting error is controlled by the probability of reaching that region. A local version covers on-site interactions, cross-density interactions and record-dependent hopping on many-mode graphs.

This is a completed restricted theorem and a constructive numerical interface. Its present significance is mathematical: it connects a positive current-state representation to the actual quantum instrument, including subsequent records and controls. The conservative certified implementation is expensive, and economical conditioning on an arbitrary supplied record remains unresolved.

The earlier geometric identity, positive two-bin construction, separate quantum certificate and failed smaller representations remain intact. I copied actual working files byte for byte; I have not treated the inaccessible attachment controls as recovered.

PRIVATE ASTRA P1 — GLOBAL POSITIVE QUARTIC DIFFUSION / COMPLETE RECORD BRIDGE
2026-10-24. New work. Earlier Fisher, Husimi, exact two-bin, and source files
are preserved separately and unchanged. Producer proof; not a novelty claim.

GOVERNING RESULT
================
For a supplied positive coherent-mixture preparation, a thermal gain/loss
bath, general number-conserving quartic Hamiltonians, passive annihilation
counts, and a common permitted-record feedback controller, there is a positive
2m-real-dimensional diffusion whose COMPLETE permitted record law approximates
the quantum record law. The diffusion retains the exact ordinary-P quantum
correction whenever the total amplitude is below an explicit threshold and
attenuates only that correction outside it. The error is bounded by a scalar
CIR excess-tail integral. At thermal preparation that integral is explicit and
exponentially small in kappa/(theta q2), for fixed mode count and coefficients.

This is a different predictor from the earlier isotropic classical SDE. Its
state-dependent real covariance must be evaluated and numerically sampled;
the earlier isotropic sampler does not automatically implement it. The result
does not assert exact ordinary-P positivity, a bounded finite posterior family,
uniform prediction after an arbitrarily rare record, or an acquired preparation.
The positive predictor and the coherent-mixture quantum certificate remain
different mathematical objects.

1. PHYSICAL MODEL, PREPARATION, AND ACCESS
========================================
Set B_j=sqrt(theta)a_j, [B_j,B_k^dagger]=theta delta_jk, theta>0. The physical
generator at a supplied control C and time t is

 H_theta=theta^(-1)[B^dagger h_theta(C,t)B+:W_C,t(B^dagger,B):],
 L_Q rho=-i[H_theta,rho]
              +sum_j[d D[a_j]+b D[a_j^dagger]]rho,
 b=kappa nu/theta, d=kappa(nu+theta)/theta, kappa,nu>0.       (1)

h_theta is Hermitian. W is a real homogeneous polynomial of bidegree (2,2)
in z,bar z. Its normal ordering is part of the definition. Both terms conserve
total quantum number. A density-density convention containing N_i^2 requires
the usual supplied normal-order linear correction; it must not be omitted.

 theta Q_c <= d I.                                       (2)

PRIVATE ASTRA P1 — LOCAL RECORD BOUNDS WITH FEEDBACK AND HOPPING
2026-10-24. New theorem and a retained failed stronger claim.

SCIENTIFIC RESULT
=================
A strong-damping condition on the ACTUAL hopping row budget controls aggregate
local-intensity tails under arbitrary permitted record feedback. This suffices
for an extensive local quantum-record error bound for density-density graphs
with hopping. It does not give a uniform tail at every named site: a finite
observation/controller example below defeats that stronger claim.

The useful invariant is therefore an aggregate mode-moment budget, rather
than an assumed stationary product intensity law or a uniformly thermal
conditional state. The proof retains the supplied joint preparation,
controller, observation access and numerical distinction.

1. SOURCE, QUANTUM INTERFACE, AND CONTROL PREMISES
================================================
Use the physical generator and coherent-mixture preparation of
GLOBAL_POSITIVE_QUARTIC_DIFFUSION_RECORD_BRIDGE.txt, with the density-edge
Hamiltonian and locally clipped covariance of
LOCAL_EDGE_POSITIVE_DIFFUSION_COROLLARY.txt. Add a Hermitian hopping matrix
h(C_t,t), now ALLOWED to depend on the permitted exposed record and retained
controller. All rates, quantum loss-subchannel constraints and common-policy
premises of those theorems remain. The reference is the continuous positive
diffusion, not the finite-jump numerical implementation.

For off-diagonal hopping assume the actual pathwise row budget

 max_i sum_(j!=i)|h_ij(C,t)|<=H                           (1)

uniformly over admitted controls and times. Hermiticity implies
|h_ij|=|h_ji|. Diagonal frequencies do not enter this budget. They remain
supplied evaluable coefficients. This H is max_i sup_C of the row sum; it is
NOT the generally larger sum_j sup_C|h_ij|.

For interaction edges e={i,j}, supplied envelopes |g_e|<=g_e,max, positive
bath allocations a_e with sum_incident a_e<=1, and 0<eta<1 define

 R_e=sqrt(I_i I_j),
 B_e=eta kappa nu a_e/(theta g_e,max),
 chi_e=min(1,B_e/R_e),
 Dhat=(kappa nu/2)I+sum_e chi_e Dq,e.                     (2)

The original hopping and density-interaction drift are retained. Local
covariance positivity and its factorization are unchanged by hopping.

The clean initial premise is product thermal positive coherent preparation
of mean scaled intensity nu per mode. A broad
